name: HomeCoin
oneLiner: HOME is HomeCoin's dollar stablecoin backed by U.S. home-loan liens and property receivables, with foreclosure as the ultimate recovery path.

obituary.obituary: HomeCoin's issuer site returned HTTP 404 on 2026-10-31 after its last archived capture on 2026-07-25, and its documentation repository has had no commits since 2022-12-16. Supply was unchanged at about 6.07M HOME and the two known pools held roughly $15K and $12K.

collateral: U.S. home-loan liens and property-backed receivables originated through the HomeCoin/Bacon lending process
pegMechanism: HOME loan origination mints tokens against servicer-issued property liens. The deployed Pool16 lendPool and redeemPool functions route USDC/HOME swaps through Curve exchange_underlying with caller-specified minimum output; they do not guarantee fixed 1:1 redemption.

notices.title: Illiquid RWA collateral
notices.message: HomeCoin collateral is property-backed receivables, so the fallback is not comparable to liquid fiat or Treasury redemption capacity.
